title: Open direct image and projection formula
statement:
For a quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$,
$Rj_*\colon D(U_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)$
maps $\Dctf(U,\mathcal O_E)$ into $\Dctf(X,\mathcal O_E)$. Proper base change
and the proper projection formula, with the tensor product
$\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}$, hold on $\Loc(\Dctf(-,\mathcal O_E))$:
the base change and projection formula maps are isomorphisms in
$\Loc(\Dctf(Y',\mathcal O_E))$, respectively $\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\mathcal O_E))$.

proof.text: Use the standing scheme and coefficient conventions of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] and [sk-def-localizing-closure], with $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$. In particular the schemes are separated of finite type over the standing field of characteristic different from $\ell$, hence qcqs by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine], applied to their structure maps to $\operatorname{Spec}k$. Clause (2) of [det-def-localizing-closure-ctf-equals-bc], specialized to $\mathcal O_E$, identifies $\Dctf(T,\mathcal O_E)=\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$ and their localizing closures, for each scheme $T$ under consideration. We use these identifications throughout the following steps; they do not identify the localizing closure with the derived-complete subcategory.

Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be quasi-compact open and let $K\in\Dctf(U,\mathcal O_E)$. Check the explicit hypotheses of the current statement of [det-thm-sf-pf-adic-open]: by step 1, $U$ and $X$ are separated finite-type schemes over the same field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$. Its coefficient sheaves $\mathcal O_{E,T}=p_T^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}$, for $T=U,X$, are precisely the pulled-back condensed coefficient sheaves used here, and its derived direct image and tensor are the module-object operations of the item. Step 1 identifies the input as $K\in\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E)$. The final conclusion of that cited statement now gives $Rj_*K\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)=\Dctf(X,\mathcal O_E)$, proving the first assertion. No unrestricted open-direct-image theorem for arbitrary schemes or discrete constant non-torsion coefficients is used.

source.place: Current DAG statement (reviewed Q28), explicit standing-setting and pulled-back-coefficient hypotheses and final conclusion; blueprint statement and Conclusion paragraph

proof.text: Fix a cartesian square with $p:X\to Y$ proper and projections $g:Y'\to Y$, $p':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$. The statement of [det-thm-sf-pf-adic-base-change] gives the canonical base change map $g^*Rp_*K\to Rp'_*g'^*K$ as an isomorphism between objects of $\Loc(\Dbc(Y',\mathcal O_E))$ for every $K\in\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))$. Step 1 converts both source and target categories to the claimed $\Loc(\Dctf)$ categories. We also record a specialization needed below: taking $g=\mathrm{id}_Y$ and $g'=\mathrm{id}_X$ in this statement shows that $Rp_*K$ belongs to $\Loc(\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E))$; inverse image along the identity is the identity, so the functor typing in that statement gives precisely this membership.

source.place: Statement, including its functor codomain; identity-square specialization

proof.text: Let $K\in\Loc(\Dctf(X,\mathcal O_E))$ and $L\in\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\mathcal O_E))$, with $p:X\to Y$ proper. Convert these memberships using step 1. Clause (2) of [det-thm-sf-pf-adic-projection] states both tensor closure of $\Loc(\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E))$ and invertibility of the proper projection formula map $Rp_*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,Y}}L\to Rp_*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}p^*L)$ in the ambient derived category. Its source belongs to $\Loc(\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E))$: step 3 places $Rp_*K$ there, and tensor closure then applies to $Rp_*K$ and $L$. Its target belongs there as well, because this full subcategory is replete by [sk-def-localizing-closure] and is isomorphic to the source. Fullness also puts the inverse in the same subcategory. Thus this very map is an isomorphism in $\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\mathcal O_E))$, as asserted. All tensors here are ordinary relative derived tensors in the ambient module-object category; no completion is applied to the localizing closure.

source.place: Clause (2), with codomain verification from the identity-square case of the preceding step
